purpose: Bind the governed create-branch repository-provider membrane and deterministic authority issuance to current operator documentation without promoting source or CI evidence into a claim that a live provider branch mutation occurred.

claims: src/providers/authorizedRepositoryMutation.ts must allow the governed FCR create_branch path to reach RepositoryProvider.createBranch only when the original FCR-issued AuthorityEnvelopeV1 still matches canonical capability github.repository.create-branch, exact repository scope, idempotency key, proposal, branch arguments, current mission-state fingerprint, tool-call identity, expiry, and envelope integrity; any drift fails closed before provider mutation.

src/founder-os-lab/authorityIssuance.ts must keep create-branch authority issuance deterministic and side-effect free: it cannot read the wall clock or generate randomness, defaults issuance to the server-observed proof timestamp, derives default tool-call identity from the already-bound idempotency key, and cannot by itself execute a provider mutation.

src/http/routes/approvals.ts must reserve create_branch before external mutation, re-read current mission state and runtime time immediately before the provider sink, and validate the original exact-action envelope through executeAuthorizedCreateBranch; ambiguous pending outcomes require reconciliation before retry.
